## Tool used

Which assessment, template, survey, or scaling aid did you use?

## Context

Audience, sector, setting, and approximate group size:

## What was unclear

## Suggested improvement

## Evidence boundary

Was this a public case, anonymised field note, or synthetic example?

## Sensitivity check

Confirm this issue does not include private, client, organisational, personal, credential, regulated, or confidential information.
